prompt: Freehand Chinese ink painting (xieyi) game sprite on transparent ground: calligraphic brush strokes that swell and taper, dry flying-white streaks, splashed wet ink that bleeds at its edges, and large areas left as bare paper. Black ink in five dilutions; the only colours are indigo-cyan (water, distance) and ink green (plants). No warm colour, no outline-and-fill, no airbrush. Orthographic side view, no cast shadow. SUBJECT: Far limestone towers as a pale indigo-grey wash, dense at the crown, crossed by a belt of mist and dissolving below. Tiles horizontally.
